subject: S04 final check B1+B2 done; agent.spec green on CI Firefox
body:
S04 final check: B1 and B2 integrated at bb53552 (8888e80 privacy, bb53552 facade + guard, rebased).

B1 (llm_privacy.py)
- "/" and "per" count as units only when a unit or denominator follows (/uL, /mm3, /hpf, /m2, /min, per mL, per day). A digit or a word never counts.
- "%" alone is no longer a unit. A percentage counts only through a lab word before the number.
- Negative tests: "call 9876543210/9876543211" (both numbers), "call 9876543210 / 9876543211 anytime" (both), "9876543210 per my mom", "9876543210% sure", "12345678/9".
- Positive tests: "12000000 per mL", "15000000/mm3", "25000000 / hpf", "neutrophils 12000000%".

B2 (AgentDiagnostics.tsx, e2e)
- The media block's YouTube video is now a click-to-load facade, matching ContentRenderer's Video and reusing the content.video_play / content.video_loads copy. Nothing contacts YouTube until an admin clicks. After the click it loads the youtube-nocookie IFrame player with origin and the strict-origin-when-cross-origin referrer.
- Only the media test clicks the facade, after first asserting that no YouTube, ytimg or googlevideo request was made. The prod-CSP test asserts the facade stays unclicked.
- The console guard now ignores lines from any frame whose origin isn't the page's (fromNonAppFrame in fixtures.ts). Lines with no source URL still count.

CI: run https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43979963174 (head b7f258a, which contains bb53552). bb53552's own run was cancelled before 4a173bb added per-commit concurrency.
- agent.spec: Firefox 54/54, Chromium 54/54, WebKit 54/54. That includes firefox-phone-390/412 :104 "discard does not record", the budget test and the media test.
- The Firefox job was then cancelled by fail-fast. Chromium failed on 18 ink-sync.spec tests (3 tests x 6 projects), which are not S04.
- lint/unit/drift/build and integration (db) succeeded.

Local
- Unit: 549+ passed.
- DB: 365 passed, 1 skipped (perf, needs the seeded corpus).
- All six Firefox agent.spec projects: 54/54, --retries=0.
- Smoke set x2, --retries=0: 36/36 and 36/36.
- typecheck, vitest, shared, biome and ruff/mypy all clean; no drift from gen:contracts or gen:requirements.
- Note: after the 0010+ migrations the local DB needed the seed importer before onboarding-based sign-in works (ensureOnboarded needs a plan template). I seeded my local stack only; CI already seeds.
- After the container restart, my seg04 containers were restarted by name.
